mapper.sql: select o.order_id, o.order_no, o.owner_id, owner.nick_name owner_name, owner.phonenumber owner_phone, o.room_id, concat(ifnull(b.building_name, ''), if(o.room_id is null, '', concat('-', r.unit_no, '-', r.room_no))) room_text, o.category_id, c.category_name, o.title, o.content, o.images, o.status, o.repair_user_id, repair.nick_name repair_user_name, o.reject_reason, o.finish_result, o.finish_images, o.accept_time, o.assign_time, o.start_time, o.finish_time, o.confirm_time, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, o.remark from prop_repair_order o left join sys_user owner on o.owner_id = owner.user_id left join prop_room r on o.room_id = r.room_id left join prop_building b on r.building_id = b.building_id left join prop_repair_category c on o.category_id = c.category_id left join sys_user repair on o.repair_user_id = repair.user_id
mapper.insert: insert into prop_repair_order(order_no, owner_id, room_id, category_id, title, content, images, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{orderNo}, #{ownerId}, #{roomId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{images}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from prop_repair_order where order_id in #{id}
mapper.select: select count(1) total_count, sum(case when status in ('0','1','2','3','4','8') then 1 else 0 end) pending_count, sum(case when status = '5' then 1 else 0 end) completed_count, ifnull(round(( select avg(e.score) from prop_repair_evaluation e inner join prop_repair_order eo on eo.order_id = e.order_id where eo.create_time >= #{startTime} and eo.create_time < #{endTime} ), 2), 0) avg_score from prop_repair_order o where o.create_time >= #{startTime} and o.create_time < #{endTime}
select o.status, count(1) title from prop_repair_order o where o.create_time >= #{startTime} and o.create_time < #{endTime} group by o.status order by o.status

select c.category_name, count(1) title from prop_repair_order o left join prop_repair_category c on o.category_id = c.category_id where o.create_time >= #{startTime} and o.create_time < #{endTime} group by c.category_name order by count(1) desc

select repair.nick_name repair_user_name, count(1) title from prop_repair_order o left join sys_user repair on o.repair_user_id = repair.user_id where o.repair_user_id is not null and o.create_time >= #{startTime} and o.create_time < #{endTime} group by repair.nick_name order by count(1) desc
